messages:
maya: Quick check — after the kernel bump to 6.2.x our private VPC edge nodes show a ~20–30ms p95 warmup delta vs hosted. Can someone grab p95 logs for /model/infer v2 on edge-07 (last 2h) and a short perf sample? :eyes:

alex: On it. Do you want raw p95 numbers or a flamegraph perf capture as well? Which timeframe exactly?

maya: Last 2 hours is fine. Raw p95 + `perf record` for a 5-minute sample should be enough.

sam: FWIW I saw similar deltas earlier this week — edge-07 rebooted yesterday and I think NIC offload flags were toggled during the image rollout.

infra-bot: Scheduled job started: run-perf-collect edge-07 /model/infer v2 5m -> /tmp/perf-edge07-2060012345.tar.gz

alex: Collected numbers:
- edge-07 p95 (current): 72ms
- hosted baseline p95: 48ms
- delta: +24ms
Uploading logs: https://internal-s3/reports/edge07-warmup-2060012345

olga: Can you paste `ethtool -k` and any NIC coalescing settings? Offload + coalescing differences often explain warmup jitter.

alex: ethtool -k shows GRO/gso/tso enabled. I tried toggling with: 
```
sudo ethtool -K eth0 rx off tx on gro on gso on tso on
```
No measurable change without a reboot.

qiao: Also check cpufreq governors and IRQ distribution. Kernel upgrade may have reverted governors to `ondemand`. That + IRQs on runtime cores = jitter.

maya: alex, can you capture `cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor` and `cat /proc/interrupts | grep eth0` and paste small snippets?

alex: governors: "ondemand" on all cores.
/proc/interrupts shows eth0 mapped to CPUs 4-7 with spikes ~15k/s during warmup.

sam: If IRQs are on those cores and irqbalance isn't pinning, that could add latency. Try isolating NIC IRQs to core 2 and pin the runtime process to cores 3-5.

maya: Experiment plan: isolate IRQs -> set affinity to core2; runtime cpuset -> cores 3-5; run 2m smoke. If p95 improves, we can automate.

alex: Running the experiment now. Also capturing a lightweight flamegraph.

infra-bot: Experiment job completed: results uploaded to https://internal-s3/reports/edge07-experiment-2060012345
Quick summary:
- p95 before: 72ms
- p95 after isolating IRQs + cpuset: 54ms
- remaining delta vs hosted: ~+6ms

olga: Partial win. Next hypothesis: MTU and offload path (packet coalescing) or hugepage differences. Which MTU do we have on edge vs hosted?

qiao: Also validate hugepages and NUMA placement. If KV cache warmup crosses NUMA boundaries that can add latency on warmup.

alex: MTU on edge-07 is 1500, hosted is 9000. I tested mtu 9000 locally -> ~3ms improvement. Hugepages: edge has 1G hugepages disabled, hosted uses 1G hugepages.

maya: Ok, action items: 
- alex: document steps to enable 1G hugepages in our private image and run a warmup experiment (follow-up)
- sam: author a small script to pin NIC IRQs and cpuset; add as a smoke experiment (PR)
- olga & qiao: validate safe kernel offload/coalescing defaults and confirm production-safe knobs
I'll open a short RFC and a checklist for private node warmup parity.

sam: I'll spin up the PR and tag you @maya — should include repro instructions and a smoke harness.

maya: Thanks all. If anyone wants to pair on the hugepages change ping me. :thumbsup:
